issues.description: StockIngredient 'name' getter is named differently across artifacts: the template defines StockIngredient.getIngredientName(), and Stock.findStockIngredient() in the template calls x.getIngredientName(), whereas the solution defines StockIngredient.getName(), and Stock.findStockIngredient() in the solution calls x.getName(). The problem statement asks students to "add getters for all the private fields" but does not mandate a getter name, so this mismatch of accessor identifiers for the same conceptual field (the ingredient name) creates an avoidable mapping burden. Students reading the template, tests, and solution may be confused which getter to implement and which name the rest of the code expects.
issues.suggestedFix: Unify the getter name for the StockIngredient 'name' field across template and solution. Prefer the conventional getName() identifier: rename the template method getIngredientName() to getName() and update any calls (e.g., in src/de/tum/cit/ase/Stock.java) to use getName(). Alternatively, if retaining getIngredientName() is preferred, change the solution's StockIngredient.getName() to getIngredientName() and update its usages so both artifacts use the same accessor name.
